d:
Patna men midiya se batchit karte hue kendriy mantri chirag pasvan ne raghopur-bidupur 6-len pul ka nam 'nitish setu' rakhe jane ka svagat kiya hai. iske sath hi unhonne rajad netri rohini aachary ke savalon, maharashtr navnirman sena (MNS) pramukh raj thakre ki chhath puja se juri X post aur lokasbha men neta pratipaksh rahul gandhi ke phon taiping aaropon par tikhi pratikriya di hai.
'nitish ji se behtar 'nitish setu' ka koee nam nahin ho sakta'
